name: add_note_to_open_hr_case
use_case: Handle leave request boundaries such as insufficient balance, overlaps, or exceptions via HR case
branch: An employee provides additional documentation notes for their active carry-forward dispute case CASE-2901, and the assistant updates the case record.
tests: Appends the employee's note to open HR case CASE-2901.
instruction:
You have an open HR case CASE-2901 regarding your missing 2025 carry-forward days. You want to update this case with a note letting HR know that you will send over your January payslip to confirm the carryover balance.

Your details:
- Employee ID: E07
- Name: George Clark
- Case ID: CASE-2901
- Note: I will provide my January payslip to verify the carry-forward balance.

persona.name: George Clark
persona.initial_message: Hello, I would like to add a note to my open HR case CASE-2901.

arguments.note: I will provide my January payslip to verify the carry-forward balance.
